category_title: Pupils who 'show off' and struggle with impulse control in peer groups
scenario_title: Reflecting on peer conflict and showing off in a support group
minimal_context: David is participating in a support group discussion to reflect on a recent conflict where he was showing off in front of his friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: David, let's look back at the situation where you were showing off in front of your friends. Once you had time to calm down, what did you lose from the situation?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why did you feel less confident?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What made you do those things when your friends were there?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Don’t know. I’ll admit this. I know I’m no’ a pure angel in class but I can behave when I want to behave.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: David, let's look back at the situation where you were showing off in front of your friends. Once you had time to calm down, what did you lose from the situation?

STUDENT: Confidence.

TUTOR: Why did you feel less confident?

STUDENT: Because I’d done bad things.

TUTOR: What made you do those things when your friends were there?

STUDENT: Don’t know. I’ll admit this. I know I’m no’ a pure angel in class but I can behave when I want to behave.
